Subject: Project Update: New Delivery Date of 14 April

Hi, I want to give you a clear, direct update on the project timeline. The delivery date has moved from our original schedule to 14 April, because the third-party integration our system depends on took longer to certify than the vendor originally indicated.

Does 14 April still work with your internal launch plans, or is there anything on your end we should factor into the final schedule? We will send a short progress note each week between now and then so you have full visibility as we head toward delivery. Best regards, [Your Name]
